column1: # eng.Canon, so strings render single-quoted ('ada') and a reach renders as
# §1  Receiverless reach — the $ sentinel builds a detached, inert lens
#     ($.name evaluates to itself, NOT to a `$ get name` chain).

column3: a receiverless reach is an inert lens value
a receiverless reach has type Reach

column1: # §2  apply — the lens "get": rebind the receiver and evaluate.

column3: apply a lens to a receiver reads the field
apply a numeric-key lens to a list
getr segment finds a present key

column1: # §3  rebind — compose, don't evaluate: swap in a receiver, stay inert data.

column3: rebind returns a (bound) lens, not the value

column1: # §4  Lens-as-Function — a receiverless reach is an arity-1 accessor in
def people [{name:"ada" age:36} {name:"bob" age:20}]  each $.name people
column3: each plucks the lens from every element

column1: def xs [{n:"a" on:true} {n:"b" on:false} {n:"c" on:true}]  each $.n (filter $.on xs)
column3: filter keeps elements whose lens is truthy
filter lens form works on a map (by value)

column1: aql:array-util import  def people [{name:"ada" age:36} {name:"bob" age:20}]  each $.name (ArrayUtil.sortby $.age people)
column3: sortby derives the sort key via the lens
getr strictness: missing key errors through apply
